_doc: PLACEHOLDER — the radial THREE-ROOM cluster (Sérgio, Round 18: 'see all the 3 rooms around you'). Read behind ?reinterp=1 only. The E1 lead room keeps the front; TWO ROOM-BAYS open off the east/west rear arcs (trans-fluid bay east, companion-identity bay west); the south wall becomes the spine — a real recessed door + the witness record shrunk to a wall terminal (the old rear witness furniture is hidden in reinterp: the ceiling witness carries presence, the terminal carries the legible record, Ethics #10). Openings are covered by SCRIMS: sealed (E1 — reads as wall in shadow) → dim (O7 — the bays become dimly legible) → open (E2+ — the scrim lifts like a shutter). COLOR LAW: every hex here already exists in data/room/era1.json — reused, never invented; e2-e4 rig hues re-derive when era2+ theme palettes land. Cluster states: sealed | dim | open.

bays._note: Two room volumes beyond the (rebuilt, segmented) east/west walls, z 1.9-3.7, interior ceiling 2.5. The fluid trans niche RELOCATES into the east bay (fluid_niche.json anchor). The west bay holds the other non-lead identity per era (non-display slugs; E4 split = open content call).

door._note: the room's real door — recessed in the south spine wall

witnessTerminal._note: the shrunk witness record surface on the south spine (4:3, same canvas)

ceilingWitness._note: R8-3: presence only — light/eye-motif, NEVER reading. A square iris (pixel discipline: 90° geometry) recessed in the ceiling over the room's center; a pale sourceless wash when awake. Dormant until the O7 first filing.

rigs._note: Per-era light targets for the era1.json light ids + scene ambient. The arc: E1 lamp-dominant night (~70/30 warm) → E2 office-grade fluorescent (~50/50, managed) → E3 platform pastel (near-shadowless diffuse, the lamp a leftover) → E4 interface-lit near-dark (the cold has won; the lamp survives as the one warm pocket, CARRIED to Maya's desk). 'hold' = T1's lamp-only breath (choreography §T1.1). 'close' kills the room for the point-cloud inversion. bayFill = the per-bay interior omnis; mayaGlow = Maya's interface light (built in cluster.ts).

pointCloud._note: The Close's constellation (R1 confirmed; Gephi-style reference, Round 2): warm orange/yellow NODES on a cool blue LINK-WEB against a NIGHT-BLUE backdrop (Round 18: not black — 'we can't see'), dense center + scattered satellites, and LABELS on the hub nodes carrying the project's knowledge network (data/strings/close_network.json, PLACEHOLDER until Sérgio's pass). The inversion: warm nodes / cool web = the lamp's temperature at network scale. Hues = the lamp pool (#F7C775/#EFA13F), the moon face (#F3EAD8), the moonlight blue (#6C7BA8); backdrop = windowPane night #2C3A5C scaled down in code (a light level, not a new hue). Links are trimmed to node surfaces and never cross the player's clear bubble (the Round-18 clipping fix).
